data.title: 久岛鸥 · 航海皮箱上的晨风海誓
data.action: 坐在复古旅行皮箱上，赤脚踩在光滑木地板上，手拉着吊带边缘微仰头，海风吹拂着淡金短发，眼眸澄澈如碧波，满载冒险的轻快。
data.location: 老旧灯塔顶层守塔人卧室，圆拱木窗外是碧海蓝天与掠过海面的海鸥
data.lighting: 金白色的清晨海面反光跃进室内，在天花板与木墙上泛起流动的水波光纹
data.mood: 海岛假日的浪漫与冒险气息，清凉通透充满活力
data.description: 老旧灯塔顶层守塔人卧室，圆拱木窗外是碧海蓝天与掠过海面的海鸥。坐在复古旅行皮箱上，赤脚踩在光滑木地板上，手拉着吊带边缘微仰头，海风吹拂着淡金短发，眼眸澄澈如碧波，满载冒险的轻快。 她微微抬眸轻语——“我的藏宝图里，其实藏着一个关于夏夜的小秘密哦。要一起去寻找终点的秘宝吗？”
data.promptProse: Perched barefoot atop her oversized vintage leather suitcase inside the top room of a sunlit coastal lighthouse, Kamome wears a breezy navy-and-white striped nautical bralette and matching cotton briefs. Tugging lightly at one shoulder strap as she tilts her head up with a bright adventurous smile, she is framed against the tall arched wooden window overlooking sparkling blue waves and soaring seagulls in clear morning sea light.
data.animaCaption: Perched barefoot atop her large vintage suitcase inside the lighthouse room in her navy-and-white striped cotton bralette and briefs, Kamome tugs one strap lightly with a bright smile. Morning sea light streams through the arched wooden window overlooking blue waves and seagulls.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a breezy navy-and-white pinstriped cotton bralette with tiny rope-knot ties and brass anchor charm paired with matching striped cotton briefs, baring her midriff and slender legs.
